summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.62/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.62 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 13, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since July 16. AAA figures put the statewide average 31¢ lower than a week ago, 39¢ lower than a month ago, and 93¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.28) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.00).
